exact.神经归零：你还在看，但已经没有人替你处理看见的东西。侧视面板合上之前，房间先一步: Nerve hit zero: you are still looking, but no one is left to process what you see. The room ends you before the side panel can close.
exact.恐惧封顶：侧视不再是观察，而是互相凝视。画面没有动，你却已经不在原来的位置。: Dread maxed out: the side glance is no longer observation, it is mutual staring. The picture did not move, but you are no longer where you were.
exact.目标记录已经 verified，可以寻找出口。: The target file is verified; you can look for the exit.
exact.目标记录仍是 uncertain：继续 inspect + record，直到证: The target file is still uncertain: keep inspecting and recording until the evidence meets the mark.
exact.证据已经够了：去取得目标档案，然后从出口撤离。: You have enough evidence: claim the target file, then leave through the exit.
exact.你停下动作，把侧视面板当成一扇需要呼吸的窗，而不是一场挑战。: You stop and treat the side panel as a window that needs a breath, not a challenge.
exact.本次不触发事件表。: This action does not trigger the event table.
exact.你推了推出门。门没有动：它要一份档案，不是你的决心。: You push the door. It does not move: it wants a file, not your resolve.
exact.专注 +2、神经 +1、恐惧 -1（按上限截断），不触发事件。: Focus +2, nerve +1, dread -1 (capped). No event is triggered.
exact.出口只接受档案；现在还没有取得目标，尝试会被拒绝并增加恐惧。: The exit only accepts a file. You have not claimed the target yet; trying will be refused and raise dread.
exact.带着 verified 档案离开，结束本局并记作成功撤离。: Leave with a verified file, end the run, and count it as a clean extraction.
exact.带着 uncertain 档案离开：会结束本局，但结局是错误记录。: Leave with an uncertain file: the run ends, but the outcome is a false record.

exact.inspect 命名现象，record 把它写成证据；证据足够后取得目标并 ex: inspect names the anomaly, record writes it as evidence; once you have enough, claim the target and extract.
exact.神经归零或恐惧达到 10 即失败；abort 随时可以诚实中止。: Nerve at zero or dread at 10 is a loss; abort can stop the run honestly at any time.

exact.有效路线：先 inspect 命名现象、record 攒证据，再取得目标并撤离；: A route that works: inspect to name the anomaly, record to bank evidence, then claim the target and leave. Worth writing into memory.
exact.神经归零即失败：inspect/move/interact 的事件都可能扣神经，: Nerve at zero is a loss: inspect/move/interact events can all cut nerve, and brace only returns 1. Plan the exit earlier.
exact.恐惧到 10 即失败：inspect/move/interact 的事件多数会加: Dread at 10 is a loss: most inspect/move/interact events raise dread, and brace only shaves 1. Do not save it for the last turn.
exact.中止既不是胜利也不是失败：这份侦察笔记可以保留，下次用 --content <c: An abort is neither a win nor a loss. Keep these notes and enter next time with --content <case-id>.
exact.本局还没结束；目前的结论只是阶段性观察，不要当成规则。: The run is not over; these conclusions are interim notes, not rules.
exact.还没有选择副本；这份结算只记录了一个空的开场。: No case was chosen; this settlement only records an empty opening.

exact.这轮不是白走：把“证据不足就取档”的教训写进 memory，下次在 claim: This exit was not wasted: write the lesson about claiming too early into memory, and count evidence before you claim next time.
exact.这轮不是白怕：把 1-3 条“本局最伤”的教训写进 memory，并标明下局继续: This scare was not wasted: write 1–3 lessons that hurt most into memory, and test them next run.
exact.这轮还在继续：把已经确认的现象写进 memory，但要标明它还没有经过撤离验证。: The run is still going: store the anomalies you have confirmed, and mark that they have not been verified by an exit.
exact.这轮先收壳：把已经冒头的观察写进 memory，并注明这是一次中止结算。: Shell out for now: store the observations that already surfaced, and mark this as an aborted settlement.
exact.用一条条命令侧眼观察，直到档案承认你看见的东西: Watch sideways, one command at a time, until the file admits what you saw
exact.一款单步命令式的 CLI 视觉恐怖：每个动作都是一条命令，每次 inspect: A turn-by-turn CLI visual horror: every action is a command, and every inspect lets the side panel look back a little longer. Four short cases — record, claim, extract, or walk out with a false record.
exact.省略 --content 时先进入副本选择，用 act choose:<case: Without --content you start at case select and enter with act choose:<case-id>; --content <case-id> starts in the case.
exact.inspect:<target-id> 命名当前现象；record 把现象写成证: inspect:<target-id> names the current anomaly; record writes it as evidence.
exact.证据达到 requiredEvidence 后取得目标才是 verified；未: Claiming the target is verified only after requiredEvidence is met; extracting earlier yields a false record.
exact.move:<room-id> 横移，interact:<id> 操作稳定/揭露/: move:<room-id> sidesteps, interact:<id> steadies / reveals / supports evidence, and brace restores focus and nerve.

exact.每个动作都是一回合。每次 inspect 都会让侧视面板多看你一眼。四个短副本：: Every action is one turn. Each inspect lets the side panel look back at you. Four short cases: record, gather proof, leave with a verified file, or walk out with the wrong record. A wrong record opens the door, and its ladder score has a hard ceiling.
